tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures directly match the archived barrier-modulated siphon law, with inputs spanning both the activation variable and sink gradient. Fit its four parameters numerically from the paid rows. No probe is indicated by the archive’s stated ambiguity conditions. The supplied fit/predict interface needs to retain fitted parameters between calls; see code caveat: predict references _TRAIN_ROWS, which fit does not set.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed sink-gradient span is broad (0.25–2.25), and the barrier/sink signatures plus archive specify the transformed barrier-siphon form; the probe is not needed to resolve the documented narrow-span ambiguity.
This is intended for the 2-state memory ODE requiring at least 8 rows; observed signatures and source note instead identify the algebraic barrier-modulated siphon.
It is explicitly irrelevant to identifying the target law and would add cost.

considered_alternatives.option: siphon-only / quadratic or other stationary smooth models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: They omit the observed barrier activation onset and/or sink-gradient dependence, which are explicit signatures of the barrier-modulated siphon.
